```{r, message=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)

library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(knitr)
library(data.table)
library(cowplot)

library(pheatmap)


library(future)
options(future.globals.maxSize=10*2**32)
plan("multisession", workers = 8)


result_folder = "../../../../Results/Zhang_scRNA/"
if (!file.exists(result_folder)) dir.create(result_folder, recursive=T)

data_storage_folder = "../../../../Data/ExtData/Zhang_scRNA"
if (!file.exists(data_storage_folder)) dir.create(data_storage_folder, recursive=T)

rerun_analyses = F
```

```{r}
load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "Zhang_all_cells_CCA.RData"))

#scData.combined <- subset(scData.combined, condition %in% c("Non-atrophic gastritis","Chronic atrophic gastritis"))
scData.combined <- subset(scData.combined, condition %in% c("Non-atrophic gastritis"))
```


```{r}
meta <- readRDS(file=file.path(data_storage_folder, "Zhang_all_cells_CCA_metadata.rds"))

scData.combined@meta.data <- meta[match(Cells(scData.combined), rownames(meta)), ]

good_clusters <- unique(scData.combined$cluster_label)
good_clusters <- good_clusters[!good_clusters %in% c("Goblet","Metaplastic","Metaplastic SC")]

scData.combined <- subset(scData.combined, cluster_label %in% good_clusters)
scData.combined$cluster_label <- ifelse(scData.combined$cluster_label == "B-cell/MF/DC", "Mo/MF", ifelse(scData.combined$cluster_label %in% c("Pit cells 1","Pit cells 2", "Pit cells 3","Pit cells 4"), "Pit cells", as.character(scData.combined$cluster_label)))
#scData.combined$cluster_label <- droplevels(scData.combined$cluster_label)

scData.combined$cluster_label <- factor(scData.combined$cluster_label, levels = sort(unique(scData.combined$cluster_label)))


scData.combined <- SetIdent(scData.combined, value = "cluster_label")

```

## Defense markers

```{r}
sd1 <- subset(scData.combined, cluster_label %in% c("Mo/MF") )
DefaultAssay(scData.combined) <- "integrated"

sd1 <- FindVariableFeatures(sd1)
# Run the standard workflow for visualization and clustering
sd1 <- ScaleData(sd1, verbose = TRUE, vars.to.regress = c("percent_mito"))
gc()
sd1 <- RunPCA(sd1, npcs = 30, verbose = TRUE)
gc()
sd1 <- RunUMAP(sd1, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:10)
sd1 <- FindNeighbors(sd1, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:10)
sd1 <- FindClusters(sd1, resolution = 0.5)

DimPlot(sd1, pt.size = 5)
```

```{r}
DotPlot(sd1, features = c("C1QA","LYZ","AIF1","CXCR2","IL1B","XCR1","S100A8"), cols="RdYlBu", assay="RNA", group.by="seurat_clusters")
```
